taxonomy.description: A prospective student-athlete introducing themselves and expressing interest.
taxonomy.label: Recruiting/Triage/Recruit Introduction

drafting.guidance: Thank the recruit for reaching out. Acknowledge only details actually present and avoid making an evaluation or recruiting promise.

taxonomy.description: A recruit sharing a schedule, academic, athletic, or recruiting update.
taxonomy.label: Recruiting/Triage/Recruit Update

drafting.guidance: Acknowledge the update without promising attendance, evaluation, or follow-up by a particular date.

taxonomy.description: A recruit sharing highlight film or a new video link.
taxonomy.label: Recruiting/Triage/Video Update

drafting.guidance: Thank the sender for the film without claiming it has already been watched or evaluated.

taxonomy.description: A parent or guardian writing about a prospective student-athlete.
examples: Writing on behalf of my son
taxonomy.label: Recruiting/Triage/Parent

drafting.guidance: Be courteous and neutral. Do not disclose private recruiting information or make commitments about the student.

taxonomy.description: A club, high-school, or college coach contacting the account owner.
taxonomy.label: Recruiting/Triage/Other Coach

drafting.guidance: Acknowledge the coach professionally without making recruiting or scheduling commitments.

taxonomy.description: A person asking about a clinic, camp, registration, timing, or logistics.
taxonomy.label: Recruiting/Triage/Camp Inquiry

drafting.guidance: Answer only from facts contained in the email or owner guidance. If details are missing, say the owner will confirm rather than inventing them.

taxonomy.description: Legitimate human administrative, operational, or institutional correspondence.
taxonomy.label: Recruiting/Triage/Administrative

drafting.guidance: Draft a neutral acknowledgement for a human-sent administrative message. Automated and bulk mail never reaches drafting: mailing-list, bulk-precedence, auto-submitted, no-reply, and bounce messages are suppressed before classification, in every drafting mode.

taxonomy.description: A legitimate human message that does not fit another reviewed category.
taxonomy.label: Recruiting/Triage/Other

drafting.guidance: Write a brief acknowledgement without inventing an answer. The owner will edit or discard it.

ai_drafting.default_guidance: Do not make admissions, roster, scholarship, evaluation, or scheduling promises. Every draft will be reviewed and edited before it is sent manually.
